t: SPG Records - Wikipedia
s: July 21, 2025 - SPG Records was an independent Toronto dance record label of the 1990s up to 2010. The label mainly produced Canadian house and dance compilations. Two of SPG's best selling compilation series were the alternative rock collections: Hardest Hits (Vols. 1-5), and Classic Alternatives (Vols. 1-3).
